When I tried to create the 09:00 job, the scheduler refused it with a gateway credentials error: "gateway cron.add requires credentials before opening a websocket". I don't have permission to change that setting myself, so I haven't tried to work around it.

Here is what I confirmed:
- You're a member of #coastal-team, so I can read it for you.
- The job I tried to create would have run every day at 09:00 Chicago time, starting tomorrow (2026-10-15). It would have DMed you a "Coastal team digest" covering new messages in #coastal-team only.

Once an admin fixes the scheduler credentials, I can create the job straight away. If you'd like a digest right now, ask me and I'll read #coastal-team and summarise it here.
